name: Moonglade
summary: In Moonglade, druids of the Cenarion Circle gather beneath an endless twilight. The valley in northern Kalimdor shelters night elf and tauren druids, while travelers on foot brave Timbermaw Hold to reach it.

sections.title: Sacred Twilight
sections.body: Moonglade lies among the mountains north of Felwood and Winterspring. Beneath Elune's moon, twilight lingers over Lake Elune'ara, at the heart of a valley sacred since kaldorei civilization began. The Burning Legion left the glade untouched in both its ancient invasions and the recent Third War, held back by Cenarius and his offspring. Keeper Remulos watches over Moonglade now, guarding nature's balance in a refuge where factional conflict has no place.

sections.title: Seat of the Circle
sections.body: Malfurion Stormrage founded the Cenarion Circle millennia ago, and Moonglade remains its headquarters. In lakeside Nighthaven, druids learn from ancient traditions. After the Third War, the Circle welcomed tauren into its ranks, following Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem's teachings. Here, Alliance and Horde loyalties are set aside. Armed sentries keep the peace, and members who turn to violence face swift justice.

sections.title: The Barrow Dens and the Dream
sections.body:
South of Lake Elune'ara lie the Stormrage Barrow Dens. For thousands of years, elven druids slept in these underground hollows as their spirits crossed the Emerald Dream. Their bodies rested under constant watch. During the Third War, Tyrande Whisperwind sounded the Horn of Cenarius here and awakened Malfurion.

The dens remain tied to the Dream. Yet strange ripples now rise from their deep tunnels, and dark whispers trouble the Emerald realm.

faq.q: How do non-druid travelers reach Moonglade?
faq.answer: On foot, you pass through Timbermaw Hold, a tunnel complex linking upper Felwood, Winterspring, and Moonglade, unless ritual magic brings you during seasonal events. Timbermaw furbolgs guard the passage fiercely, and outsiders must prove their goodwill to earn safe conduct.

faq.q: Why can Horde and Alliance walk together peacefully here?
aliases: can horde and alliance fight here
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle governs Moonglade, serving nature rather than politics. Moonglade Wardens throughout Nighthaven attack anyone who starts violence against those in good standing with the Circle.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Nighthaven?
faq.answer: Nighthaven is Moonglade's main settlement, where the Cenarion Circle dwells and works. Trainers, caretakers, and sanctuaries give kaldorei and tauren druids places to confer about the health of Azeroth's wild lands.

faq.q: Who rules Moonglade in Malfurion Stormrage's absence?
faq.answer: Keeper Remulos watches over Moonglade from the Shrine of Remulos while Malfurion Stormrage is absent. With senior Circle members such as Dendrite Starblaze, he tends the sacred grounds and directs efforts to heal the world.

faq.q: What rests beneath the Stormrage Barrow Dens?
faq.answer: The Stormrage Barrow Dens are deep chambers where druids entered long communion with the Emerald Dream. Their deep wings still hold powerful conduits to the Dream, though recent disturbances suggest unsettling nightmares are stirring within.

faq.q: Why do druids have special flight paths out of Nighthaven?
faq.answer: Silva Fil'naveth, the hippogryph master, and Bunthen Plainswind, the wind rider keeper, offer druids direct passage from Nighthaven to Rut'theran Village and Thunder Bluff. These routes help the order travel between its sacred grove and its racial homelands.

angles.text: As a druid, Moonglade is your sacred home and sanctuary. Your spiritual bond lets you teleport here from anywhere across Azeroth, consult masters like Dendrite Starblaze, commune with great spirits, and master forms such as aquatic form.
As a tauren, your place in the Cenarion Circle renews an ancient bond with Cenarius. Hamuul Runetotem championed your inclusion, which Moonglade honors despite the night elves' long seclusion.
As a night elf, Moonglade was your people's spiritual heartland for ten millennia and the resting place of your sleeping archdruids. Elune's enduring blessing sheltered it.
